newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia bourse at new highs, led by Hoiu, Hansa.
newsitem.headline: Estonia bourse at new highs, led by Hoiu, Hansa.

text.p: Hansapank and Hoiupank kept the bourse pushing to new closing records on Friday, with Hansapank also setting a new best level.
However, some dealers said prices were too high and were waiting for a correction, especially in Hoiupank.
Total trade on the main list was 81.3 million kroons and the Talse index rose 1.94 percent to close at a record 363.53.
Hoiupank led trade during the day to close 3.55 kroons higher at 225 kroons, matching a previous best, after turning over 28.8 million kroons.
"We are expecting a correction down from this level, but we cannot say when it will happen," one trader said.
"If the stock (Hoiupank) does not come off soon, then this level could form a floor and hold the price over the next two weeks," another dealer said.
Dealers think interest in Hoiupank is mostly local as it is still due to release its revised profit estimate for 1997.
Hansapank is seen benefiting from foreign interest with consistent trade in Helsinki, where it is also quoted, supporting the stock.
Hansapank turned over 26.9 million kroons and ended at a new high of 201.88 kroons, up 5.78 kroons. In Helsinki, Hansapank traded up to 75.10 markka after opening at 74.50.
On the free market, 13.7 million kroons changed hands with Norma the most active stock.
Norma saw trade of 7.5 million kroons to close at 90 kroons, up 1.25 kroons.
